title: The four tiers
desc: Tier 1 is a small fix with locked tests. Tier 2 is a normal change, with locked tests, a plan, and a review. Tier 3 covers login, payments, and user data, and adds a review on the server. Tier 4 covers data, production, and the locks, and adds an approval by a person.
